goal: Implement OAuth2 Google authentication with secure HTTP-only cookie sessions and user profile endpoint

tasks.title: Audit Current Session and Auth Middleware
tasks.description: Inspect existing express middleware, user schema in Prisma, and environment variable conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Document current session cookie attributes (sameSite, secure, httpOnly)
Confirm user model fields for googleId and avatarUrl

tasks.title: Define OAuth2 Route Contracts and Token Types
tasks.description: Specify request/response TypeScript interfaces for /auth/google, /auth/callback, and /api/me.
acceptance_criteria: Typed interfaces for GoogleProfile payload and session claims
Error response schema definitions for expired or invalid tokens

tasks.title: Implement OAuth Handlers and Session Store
tasks.description: Implement OAuth verification, session cookie issuance, and user synchronization.
acceptance_criteria: ID token verified against Google public keys
HTTP-only session cookie set with 7-day TTL
GET /api/me returns user profile or 401 Unauthorized

tasks.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Auth Routes
tasks.description: Write automated Supertest integration tests mocking Google token verification responses.
acceptance_criteria: Successful login exchanges mock token for session cookie
Tampered CSRF state parameter returns 400 Bad Request
All test runs pass in CI test runner

tasks.title: Security and OWASP Audit on Cookie Handling
tasks.description: Audit cookie flags, timing attack vulnerabilities on token comparisons, and secret management.
acceptance_criteria: Verify constant-time comparison on CSRF tokens
Confirm no access tokens or client secrets are exposed in client logs
Check SameSite=Lax or Strict on all session cookies
